from griffe.extensions import Extension
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

class CheckedExtension(Extension):
    """Extension that marks loaded functions as checked."""
    pass

# Aggregate extensions the way griffe expects
extensions = [CheckedExtension()]

# Load the package with extension enabled
loader = GriffeLoader(extensions=extensions)
module = loader.load("mypkg")

# Add [checked] to all function docstrings
def mark_functions_checked(obj):
    if obj.is_function and obj.docstring:
        obj.docstring.value += " [checked]"
    for child in obj.members.values():
        mark_functions_checked(child)

mark_functions_checked(module)

print(module)

from griffe.extensions import Extension

    pass

# Aggregate extensions the way griffe expects
extensions = [CheckedExtension()]

def mark_functions_checked(obj):
